svg.aria-label: Human mannequin squat with highlighted working muscle regions
svg.metadata: Human geometry: Blender Studio Human Base Meshes v1.4.1, CC0. Motion: Carnegie Mellon Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, subject13 capture30, adapted to this body. Source capture funded by NSF EIA-0196217. Muscle colors are illustrative, not measured activation. SVG contains vector paths only.
